name: Science and Technology
subject: Science and Technology
description: Here you will find the expectations and learning for the five areas of study for Grade 2.

strands.title: STEM Skills and Connections
strands.describer: Throughout Grade 2, in connection with the learning in the Life Systems, Matter and Energy, Structures and Mechanisms, and Earth and Space Systems strands, students will:

overall_expectations.title: STEM Investigation and Communication Skills
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 2, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
overall_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems
specific_expectations.text_html: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems

specific_expectations.text: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials
specific_expectations.text_html: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials

specific_expectations.text: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes

overall_expectations.title: Coding and Emerging Technologies
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 2, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life
overall_expectations.text_html: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life

specific_expectations.text: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on decomposing problems into smaller steps
specific_expectations.text_html: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on decomposing problems into smaller steps

specific_expectations.text: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life

overall_expectations.title: Applications, Connections, and Contributions
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 2, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

specific_expectations.text: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in their home and community, and how these applications address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in their home and community, and how these applications address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities

strands.title: Life Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess ways in which animals have an impact on society and the environment, and ways in which human activities have an impact on animals and the places where they live
overall_expectations.text_html: assess ways in which animals have an impact on society and the environment, and ways in which human activities have an impact on animals and the places where they live

specific_expectations.text: examine impacts that animals can have on society and the environment, and describe some ways in which any negative impacts can be minimized
specific_expectations.text_html: examine impacts that animals can have on society and the environment, and describe some ways in which any negative impacts can be minimized

specific_expectations.text: assess impacts of various human activities on animals and the places where they live, and describe practices that can minimize negative impacts
specific_expectations.text_html: assess impacts of various human activities on animals and the places where they live, and describe practices that can minimize negative impacts

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding that animals grow and change and have distinct characteristics
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding that animals grow and change and have distinct characteristics

specific_expectations.text: compare physical characteristics of various animals, including characteristics that are constant and those that change
specific_expectations.text_html: compare physical characteristics of various animals, including characteristics that are constant and those that change

specific_expectations.text: describe the locomotion of various animals
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the locomotion of various animals

specific_expectations.text: describe the life cycle of a variety of animals, including insects, amphibians, birds, and mammals
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the life cycle of a variety of animals, including insects, amphibians, birds, and mammals

specific_expectations.text: compare changes in the appearance and behaviour of various animals as they go through a complete life cycle
specific_expectations.text_html: compare changes in the appearance and behaviour of various animals as they go through a complete life cycle

specific_expectations.text: describe adaptations, including physical and/or behavioural characteristics, that allow various animals to survive in their natural environment
specific_expectations.text_html: describe adaptations, including physical and/or behavioural characteristics, that allow various animals to survive in their natural environment

strands.title: Matter and Energy
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess ways in which liquids and solids and their uses can have an impact on society and the environment
overall_expectations.text_html: assess ways in which liquids and solids and their uses can have an impact on society and the environment

specific_expectations.text: assess practices related to the use, storage, and disposal of liquids and solids in the home in terms of the effects on personal health and safety and on the environment, and suggest ways to improve these practices
specific_expectations.text_html: assess practices related to the use, storage, and disposal of liquids and solids in the home in terms of the effects on personal health and safety and on the environment, and suggest ways to improve these practices

specific_expectations.text: assess the impacts of changes of state of liquids and solids on humans and on environments
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impacts of changes of state of liquids and solids on humans and on environments

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the properties and physical changes of liquids and solids
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the properties and physical changes of liquids and solids

specific_expectations.text: identify various types of matter in natural and built environments as liquids or solids
specific_expectations.text_html: identify various types of matter in natural and built environments as liquids or solids

specific_expectations.text: describe the properties of liquids and solids
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the properties of liquids and solids

specific_expectations.text: describe properties of liquid water and solid water, and identify the conditions that cause changes from one state to the other
specific_expectations.text_html: describe properties of liquid water and solid water, and identify the conditions that cause changes from one state to the other

specific_expectations.text: identify conditions in which the states of liquids and solids remain constant and conditions that can cause their states to change
specific_expectations.text_html: identify conditions in which the states of liquids and solids remain constant and conditions that can cause their states to change

specific_expectations.text: describe some ways in which liquids and solids can be combined to make useful mixtures
specific_expectations.text_html: describe some ways in which liquids and solids can be combined to make useful mixtures

specific_expectations.text: classify solid objects and materials in terms of their buoyancy and in terms of their ability to absorb or repel water
specific_expectations.text_html: classify solid objects and materials in terms of their buoyancy and in terms of their ability to absorb or repel water

specific_expectations.text: explain the meaning of international symbols that give us information on the safety of substances
specific_expectations.text_html: explain the meaning of international symbols that give us information on the safety of substances

strands.title: Structures and Mechanisms
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the impact of simple machines on society and on the environment
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the impact of simple machines on society and on the environment

specific_expectations.text: assess the impact of simple machines on the daily lives of people in various communities
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impact of simple machines on the daily lives of people in various communities

specific_expectations.text: assess the impact on the environment of technologies that use simple machines to facilitate movement
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impact on the environment of technologies that use simple machines to facilitate movement

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of movement and ways in which simple machines help to move objects
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of movement and ways in which simple machines help to move objects

specific_expectations.text: describe different ways an object can move
specific_expectations.text_html: describe different ways an object can move

specific_expectations.text: identify ways in which the position of an object can be changed
specific_expectations.text_html: identify ways in which the position of an object can be changed

specific_expectations.text: identify the six basic types of simple machines: lever, inclined plane, wedge, pulley, wheel and axle, and screw
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the six basic types of simple machines: lever, inclined plane, wedge, pulley, wheel and axle, and screw

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which each type of simple machine is used in daily life to make tasks easier
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which each type of simple machine is used in daily life to make tasks easier

specific_expectations.text: compare, qualitatively or quantitatively, the force required to move an object using various simple machines to the force required to move the object without using a simple machine
specific_expectations.text_html: compare, qualitatively or quantitatively, the force required to move an object using various simple machines to the force required to move the object without using a simple machine

strands.title: Earth and Space Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess ways in which the actions of humans have an impact on the quality of air and water, and create plans to protect these resources
overall_expectations.text_html: assess ways in which the actions of humans have an impact on the quality of air and water, and create plans to protect these resources

specific_expectations.text: assess the impact of human activities on air and water, taking various perspectives into consideration, including those of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit, and plan a course of action to protect the quality of the air and/or water in the local community
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impact of human activities on air and water, taking various perspectives into consideration, including those of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit, and plan a course of action to protect the quality of the air and/or water in the local community

specific_expectations.text: assess their personal and household uses of water, and create a plan to use water responsibly
specific_expectations.text_html: assess their personal and household uses of water, and create a plan to use water responsibly

specific_expectations.text: examine the availability of fresh water and drinking water around the world, and describe the impact on communities
specific_expectations.text_html: examine the availability of fresh water and drinking water around the world, and describe the impact on communities

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 2, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the properties of air and water, including water in various states, and of ways in which living things depend on air and water for their survival
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the properties of air and water, including water in various states, and of ways in which living things depend on air and water for their survival

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the key properties of air and water
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the key properties of air and water

specific_expectations.text: identify sources of water in the natural and built environments
specific_expectations.text_html: identify sources of water in the natural and built environments

specific_expectations.text: describe the stages of the water cycle, including evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the stages of the water cycle, including evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection

specific_expectations.text: identify the three states of water in the environment, and describe how temperature changes affect the state of water within the water cycle
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the three states of water in the environment, and describe how temperature changes affect the state of water within the water cycle

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which living things, including humans, depend on air and water
